newsitem.title: UK: Mosaic in talks to buy Bolton FC.
newsitem.headline: Mosaic in talks to buy Bolton FC.

text.p: Mosaic Investments Plc said on Thursday that it is talks with first division soccer club Bolton Wanderers Footbal & Athletic Company as part of its policy of looking for suitable acquisitions.
Mosaic shares were suspended at 51-1/2 pence, 5-1/2 pence up on the day, at the request of the company.
The company's announcement follows speculation in the Daily Express newspaper that David Williams, Mosaic's chairman, has been in discussions with Bolton.

The paper said that Williams may use Mosaic as a vehicle to purchase the club. It said that under one proposal Mosaic would issues shares to Bolton shareholders in a deal that would value the football club around 25 million pounds ($40.25 million).
